name: White Labs Brewing Co - San Diego
notes: Own site (whitelabsbrewingco.com/san-diego-cal/) embeds this PDF beer menu via EmbedPress. Each house beer is fermented with 1-3 different yeast strains served side-by-side, each a distinct tasting profile, priced identically per beer at Full/8oz/4oz pours - filed each yeast variant x pour size as a separate row. Guest beer menu (8 taps) has no prices listed anywhere and was dropped per no-invented-prices rule. This is a brewery whose kitchen serves pizza/food (per brewbound.com coverage of a 2020s kitchen addition), but no food menu with prices could be found on the site, in search results, or via a toasttab.com guess (403s); only the beer menu is filed. Growler/crowler to-go sizes listed with no price, dropped.

name: Sprinkles La Jolla
notes: Confirmed permanently closed - not_found, not blocked. NBC San Diego (nbcsandiego.com) reports Sprinkles Cupcakes abruptly and permanently closed all its stores nationwide on December 31, 2025, explicitly naming the La Jolla location (8855 Villa La Jolla Dr) as one of the closures. Independently corroborated by wusa9.com (employee confirmed by phone), timesofsandiego.com, nypost.com, and Yelp's own listing now reading 'SPRINKLES LA JOLLA - CLOSED'. This matches why the batch's given website 404s. Stale UberEats/order.online storefronts still show a cached menu/prices but are leftover listings from before the January 2026 closure, not evidence the store is open.

Not closed. Given website ginzasushisd.com is an expired/parked Namecheap domain, consistent with the rename. No priced menu source found for Gintaro Sushi: zmenu.com returned 403, no DoorDash/UberEats/Grubhub listing located (an UberEats 'Ginza Sushi & Asian Fusion' store is a same-named but unrelated Oregon City/Portland OR chain location, confirmed via its own listings - not this restaurant, correctly excluded per outside-city rule). SinglePlatform and Yelp menu tab both carry only the pre-rename 'Ginza Sushi' menu, which is stale.
